name: sf-observer-order-of-execution
displayName: Applying DevOps Observability to Salesforce Metadata
description: IDE-native, pre-deployment observability for Salesforce record-triggered execution flow.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:extension && esbuild test/e2e/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outfile=dist/e2e/suite.cjs && esbuild test/e2e/runTest.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:vscode --external:@vscode/test-electron --outfile=dist/e2e/runTest.mjs && node dist/e2e/runTest.mjs
scripts.eval:pilot: npm run build:eval && node dist/eval/cli.mjs pilot
scripts.eval:main: npm run build:eval && node dist/eval/cli.mjs main
scripts.eval:repeat: npm run build:eval && node dist/eval/cli.mjs repeat --repeats 5
scripts.eval:aggregate: npm run build:eval && node dist/eval/cli.mjs aggregate
scripts.exp:selftest: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs selftest
scripts.exp:generate: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs generate main
scripts.exp:validate-plan: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs validate-plan
scripts.exp:freeze-plan: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs freeze-plan main
scripts.exp:walking-skeleton: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs walking-skeleton
scripts.exp:walking-skeleton:org: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs walking-skeleton:org
scripts.exp:pilot:org: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs pilot:org
scripts.exp:main:org: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs main:org
scripts.exp:readiness:org: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs readiness:org
scripts.exp:pilot:freeze-plan: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs pilot:freeze-plan
scripts.exp:org:check: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs org:check
scripts.exp:reconstruct: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs reconstruct
scripts.exp:aggregate: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs aggregate
scripts.exp:package: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs package
scripts.exp:stats: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs stats
scripts.exp:schedule: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs schedule
scripts.exp:power: npm run build:exp && node dist/experiment/cli.mjs power
